name: Saikyou no Bakunyuu Kendo o Niku Onaho Haramase Shinagara Musou Suru Taima Seikatsu
original_name: 最強の爆乳剣奴を肉オナホ孕ませしながら無双する退魔性活
source:
Old Japan was under threat of an evil scourge. Though weak, the fellow rescued the mighty swordstress Hazuki. She mistook his motive and fell in love---offering her glorious virgin hole! Quaff from my chalice, plow my field, she urged him, happy to service her rescuer, as his dagger plunged into her flesh forging a bond of utter loyalty and love.
